title: Forwarded: Theo's emails about Mara's account

versions.body:
Fwd 1 — From Connect, Sep 20, 2025, to mara.quinn@calder-mail.com:
"Your recovery email was changed to r•••••@bl-ops.net. If this wasn't you, secure your account."

Fwd 2 — From SpillCheck, Jan 20, 2026:
"mara.quinn@calder-mail.com was found in the Eastfield Neighbors breach."

Fwd 3 — From Connect Support, Jan 22, 2026:
"We reviewed the account you reported and found no violation of our Community Rules. To memorialize an account, please submit a death certificate."

(theo: she died july 2. I have the certificate. I just couldn't send it.)

When someone passes away, family members can ask us to memorialize their account. Memorialized accounts can't be logged into and show 'Remembering' next to the name. You'll need a death certificate or obituary. Requests are reviewed within 30 days.

Calder Mill (1887–2009) was a textile mill on the Eastfield waterfront. At its peak it employed 1,400 people. Locals sometimes call it 'the old girl'. The site is the subject of the proposed Eastfield Waterfront development. The 'Save the Mill' campaign (2024–2025) gathered 4,100 signatures.
